## Target context
- Repo: DontPanic-agent-command-surface
- Env: dev
- Project: (none)
- Command: 0 (see structured target_context.commands_run)

[F006] All green. Here's how I addressed each finding.

**[medium, correctness] command-like handoff line not an exact argv (`agent_guide.py:190`)** — In `_render_local_decision_handoff`, I split the rendered handoff so the example's description sits on its own `  # <description>` comment line and the `dontpanic` line is now exact inventory argv only (`  dontpanic dashboard open`). Verified by rendering the guide: all seven `dontpanic`-prefixed lines are now bare argv with no trailing description.

**[medium, test_coverage] parity test only proved *some* lines match** — I rewrote `test_guide_safe_examples_come_from_the_inventory` to collect *every* line that (stripped) starts with `dontpanic ` and assert the set of any lines absent from the inventory-derived argv set is empty (`drift == []`), rather than filtering to the matching subset and counting. This now fails if any command-like line — including the previously-passing handoff line — deviates from inventory argv, while still asserting at least one example per example-bearing class.

**[low, style] Ruff failures (I001, UP012, UP037)** — Applied the auto-fixable changes: combined the two `from dontpanic_orchestrate import agent_brief` / `command_guidance` lines into one sorted import (I001), changed `.encode("utf-8")` to `.encode()` (UP012), and removed the quotes from `def write_guide(home) -> object:` (UP037). In the test file I collapsed the four separate `from dontpanic_orchestrate import …  # noqa: E402` lines into one paren
